title: Steward credential disposition record (v2)
description: One independently verified disposition for one credential-shaped finding (#2283). Stored at founder/steward/security-dispositions/<debt-short-id>-<fingerprint>-<occurrence>.json. Bound to the finding (path, pattern, fingerprint, occurrence among identical tokens in the file, sha256 of the normalized line), not to the whole file: an unrelated edit does not reopen it, a changed token or line does. v2 replaces v1's whole-file fileSha256. The consumer (src/gaia_cli/steward/credentialDispositions.py) additionally requires verifiedBy to differ from author, exactly one claimant per finding, and the ruling and policy decision records to be decided and accepted by the desk validator.

debtId.description: The file's stable credential_leak debt id.

line.description: Informational: the line at review time. Not part of identity.

occurrence.description: Index among live findings in the file sharing this pattern and fingerprint. One record resolves exactly one occurrence.

lineSha256.description: sha256 of the whitespace-normalized line the token sits on.

verifiedBy.description: Independent verifier id, distinct from author.
